_what: The relay's /v2/games?sport=wnba answers read through the relay self-probe (mcp probe_relay_route) on 2026-10-31, all status 200. scripts/check-nba-board.mjs drives the generator's WNBA read from these.
_why_these: The generator's WNBA read has to treat an off-season day as a CLEAN empty board, or the daily run goes red every day of the winter. The last WNBA game day of 2026 is 10-31 (one game, tipping 2026-11-01T00:00Z). The two empty days are the day after and a mid-winter date; both answer source espn-wc with games [] and count 0, so an empty off-season board is not an error and not a failover.
_not_observed: The relay can answer a WNBA request from its KV secondary (source 'wnba-kv', with fetchedAt and staleSeconds) when ESPN fails, and 502 {error} when both fail. Both were READ from field-relay-nba src/index.js (_trySecondary in handleV2Games) on 2026-10-31, not observed. The check builds them; this file does not contain them.
